pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark brown patches with serrated, non-uniform edges. The gradients between dark and light regions are relatively sharp. Spatial area of patches varies, with larger, more blocky patches on the neck and smaller, more stellate patches on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of cream-colored negative space forming a topological graph. Junction nodes connect multiple patches. The pixel thickness of the corridors is variable, becoming wider and less defined towards the lower ventral region of the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the mane. The individual hairs create a soft, blurred edge against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark-plumaged bird is perched directly on the dorsal mane in the upper neck region.
